title: Chapter 44: Bold Ideas
content:
Chapter 44: Bold Ideas

Wu Qing and Meng chatted for a while, and after making the atmosphere comfortable, they got down to business.

"Meng, I came here this time to discuss something, and I also want to ask you some questions."

"Is it about the evil god believers? I received intelligence today saying that you fought against them repeatedly in the wild, and won repeatedly, and drove all their mopping-up troops back to the city. I couldn't believe it!"

"But when I saw you in person and the army you led, I believed it!"

"With a lord like you and the army under your command, it's not surprising to create such a record!"

Meng praised Wu Qing and the Zerg army.

His praise came from the heart. Although Wu Qing looked gentle and humble, he had a temperament that he had developed from commanding the army to fight everywhere. People who really know the business can see some clues.

The Zerg army's integrated momentum and hidden boundless fighting spirit can be seen by anyone with a little military knowledge.

It is beyond doubt that such a lord and such an army dared to go to the wild and fight a field battle with the army of the evil god believers under such circumstances.

"This also depends on the Zerg army. It is their bravery and fearlessness that can achieve such a record."

"Zerg? I have heard of it before. It is a general term for a type of race among our native races, but it feels different from the Zerg in your territory."

Meng took the opportunity to ask about the origin of the Zerg. He had never seen or heard of the interstellar Zerg.

"The Zerg is a newly born race, and it is hostile to the evil god. Their supreme leader is the mysterious master. He may be a strong man who grew up from the native land in ancient times."

"The master's strength is comparable to that of the evil god. He cannot interfere too much in the affairs of this world. By chance, he chose me as the spokesperson of this world."

"Therefore, I can lead the Zerg to fight and contribute to this world and the Zerg master."

Wu Qing briefly described the background setting of the Zerg in this world.

The strong tribes among the native races in this world are all protected by strong people. It is very reasonable to create a powerful master for the Zerg.

"So that's it! Are you new to the camp confrontation in this world?"

"Yes, we have been hiding from the world and only came here recently. Daxia Territory is our first territory."

He raised his head and looked in the direction of the Endless Mountains, and said with some melancholy: "The Endless Mountains is a good place to hide from the world! Now more and more native races choose to hide from the world. You are coming out at this time, which is really admirable!"

"Come! Drink a bowl!"

He raised the big bowl on the table, which was filled with liquid similar to wine.

The two of them clinked the bowls and drank a big bowl of wine in one gulp.

The natural laws or some rules of many worlds are similar, which leads to many similar things in many worlds, such as this wine, which also exists in this world.

Wu Qing drank it and felt good.

"This is the sphere of influence of the Tengu clan. You have just been born, so it is not easy to develop!"

"Oh? What's the problem with the Tengu clan?"

"There is no big problem with the Tengu clan. It's just that the current head of the clan has limited management skills and is ruthless in suppressing the development of other races!"

"Look at my territory. It has been developed for so many years, but there are only this small population. I spent a lot of effort to get so many people, but they are still afraid of it!"

"You have seen the result of their doing this. They were beaten to pieces by the bear goblins!"

"If they don't win another game, they will lose nearly half of their territory!"

When Meng talked about the Tengu clan, he was obviously a little contemptuous.

Wu Qing realized that the Tengu clan was indeed a threat. If the Great Xia Territory wanted to develop, it had to overcome this hurdle first.

"What is the Tiger Territory's plan? The main force of the bear goblins may be dispatched tomorrow. I think the Tiger Territory is likely to bear the brunt and become the target of attack." Wu Qing asked Meng directly. Knowing Meng's plan, the next topic was easier to talk about. "My original plan was to defend the city and fight the bear goblins. If they choose to attack me with all their strength, I can only blame myself for my bad luck!" "At worst, I will fight to the death!" "It's just that the Tengu tribe took advantage of me, which is a bit unwilling!" "But I guess the main force of the bear goblins will not come to attack me. The priests of the evil god are smart and will not let the Tengu tribe take advantage of me!" Meng said this and looked at Wu Qing seriously. "Now that you and the Zerg have intervened, I suddenly have a bolder idea!"

"Do you want to do a big one?"

Wu Qing didn't even think about it, patting his chest and said, "The Zerg are the most warlike! There is nothing we don't want to do if there is a war!"

"Haha, I knew it! You are all a bunch of warmongers!"

"The current situation is that the army of the bear goblins is approaching and ready to go, and the Tengu tribe has assembled its main force and is ready to have a decisive battle with the bear goblins!"

"The outcome of this decisive battle may determine the ownership of this area in the future!"

"Those of us who are still on the front line are abandoned by the Tengu tribe and are cannon fodder to interfere with the enemy!"

"To be honest, except for my Tiger Territory, the combat power of other territories is almost insignificant!"

"Now with the variable of you, everything has become different!"

"As long as we join forces and contact other small territories around us to form a coalition and support each other, we may become the third largest force in this area and influence the regional situation!"

"In this way, our development will no longer be restricted by other races!"

"There is plenty of land and population in this world, it depends on whether you have the strength to obtain it!"

"As long as you have the strength, you have everything!"

"Wu Qing, what do you think of my idea?!"

Meng looked at Wu Qing with some expectation.

Wu Qing didn't expect that before he spoke, Meng proposed such a radical plan to form a three-legged tripod with the Tengu clan and the Bear Goblin clan.

Fierce tiger, fierce tiger, with a fierce tiger in his heart! This tiger lord is really not simple.

He has a background, a story, ideas, and ambitions.

Most importantly, he is also very capable.

Wu Qing couldn't tell his age and strength, but his strength was definitely more than one star. He was the strongest person Wu Qing had ever seen since he came to this world, except for the weirdness.

He was in a hurry to come to the Tiger Territory this time, and his purpose was to contact these territories and try to form a united front to jointly deal with the upcoming crisis.

Wu Qing did not need these territories to contribute much. He had to fight the war with the bear goblins anyway, so why not let the people of these territories cheer behind him to increase the reputation of the Zerg and the territory?

As long as the Zerg fights crazily enough, he will completely establish the label of "the benevolent fool lord".

Wu Qing thinks this label is very useful. "Kindness" can attract the people of the territory, and "fools" can attract the lords. By attracting both of them and forming a united front, the development of the Great Xia Territory is just around the corner.
